profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer - Equipment Automation, Systems Integrations, MES, and BI solutions.
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer that is currently focused on equipment host automation, MES enhancements, and systems integrations. I am chair for our global automation group and member of our global architecture review committee. I'm actively coding in Java, Groovy, C#, and VB. I am currently using Oracle SQL and MSSQL databases. I'm currently using Jira for ticketing, Git for source control, and confluence for documentation.
